turns.replyText:
How do I use it correctly to get the best result?

Great question! Here's how to get the best results with your Mesa Loop: 💧

Using it:

Twist the straw into the lid until it locks securely — no tilting needed when drinking
Click the button up/down to lock or unlock the lid (keeps it leak-proof when locked)
Use the folding loop handle to grab and go with just a finger

Keeping it in top shape:

Both the bottle and lid are top rack dishwasher safe
Disassemble the lid before cleaning — remove the silicone plug and straw
Place the straw upright in the dishwasher so water flows through it during the wash cycle
Air dry everything thoroughly before storing
Don't microwave any part of it

Pro tip: The airflow relief valve in the lid enhances your drinking experience, making it easier to sip without effort!

Following these steps will help your Mesa Loop perform its best and last a long time. You've got this! 😊
